provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: plt.hold(True) (L92) was removed in matplotlib 3.0, so the script fails on modern matplotlib.
audit_member_text: Runtime API defect at L92: modern matplotlib.pyplot no longer exposes hold; the resulting AttributeError occurs before the trajectory plot and before all three writes at L96 and L107-L108. Plot hold is already implicit and the call is unnecessary.

base_member_text: Same spin-up inconsistency as the MATLAB version: angle uses omega=speed0/Rship while rship<Rship during t<t0, so actual speed is below speed0 (L76-L88).
audit_member_text: Nominal/actual speed mismatch across L60, L77, L82, and L88: speed0 fixes only the angular rate at final Rship, while the changing radius adds radial speed and scales tangential speed. The saved actsp therefore differs from speed0 during the ramp.

base_member_text: Differences from the MATLAB sibling: the vessel file here has 4 columns including actsp (L101-L105) and is named vessel_001.txt, versus 3 columns and vessel_0001 in mk_depth.m; which format the FUNWAVE-TVD vessel module actually expects is not determinable from this file.
The elif at L35 makes beach and island branches exclusive (identical net behavior to the MATLAB two-if version because r cannot be both >450 and <100, but structurally different).
np.savetxt default format writes full-precision scientific notation; whether FUNWAVE-TVD readers accept this for depth.txt/vessel_001.txt is not verifiable here.

audit_member_text: Grid centering at L15-L16 yields even-sized coordinate ranges -500..498 rather than symmetric endpoints; saved vessel shifts at L103-L104 use the same origin, but intended cell-center/edge convention is undocumented.
Matplotlib pcolor at L49 does not specify shading while x/y lengths equal dep dimensions; display coverage/acceptance depends on Matplotlib version.
